subject: infoschema: rewrite SchemaSimpleTableInfos for infoschema v2 to avoid network (#55088)
summary: Replaces `infoschemaV2.SchemaSimpleTableInfos` from TiKV snapshot-meta `ListSimpleTables` (network) to an in-memory scan of the V2 `byName` index with MVCC-style dedup (tombstone-aware, schema-version filtered). Adds a targeted test covering special schemas, normal schemas, and snapshot infoschema behavior.
